path: climb upward in the current column to the nearest orange pixel; after each exposed hit, turn right under the contiguous orange run and continue from the right exit; stop in the notch below an orange roof, or at the top edge if no orange remains above
trajectory: paint the vertical approach and horizontal under-run route red
dst: terminal top-edge cell or notch cell below the blocking orange roof
transform: passed orange hit pixels become teal; the cell below a hit becomes yellow and the right exit cell becomes green; place a marker at the terminal cell and keep all other pixels unchanged
